blocks.html: I’m reaching out because {{BUSINESS_NAME}} looks like the kind of {{BUSINESS_TYPE}} we would like to speak with: premium service, thoughtful presentation and clients who care how their colour looks beyond the treatment room.

Sunless by Jimmy Coco is the professional tanning line created by Jimmy Coco, known for Hollywood and red-carpet tanning. The method is centred on believable, undertone-aware colour and a polished client experience.
Eligible U.S. professional partners can request a complimentary 100 ml professional trial sample. We confirm current sample availability for your business before shipping.
Or reply INFO and I will keep it straightforward.

messages.title: Color clients trust in daylight
messages.preview: A considered approach to depth, undertone and a natural-looking finish.
messages.eyebrow: The result beyond the treatment room
messages.headline: Color clients trust in daylight.

blocks.html: The real test of a professional tan is not how it looks in the treatment room. It is how it reads later — in daylight, photographs, evening light and the events the client booked it for.

The Malibu professional formula is designed as a universal bronze, 10% DHA solution with a stated 6–8-hour development window. The professional site positions the finish as natural-looking, soft-focus and anti-orange, with hydration-led formula features.
That gives your team a stronger consultation conversation: considered depth and a finish designed to look believable, rather than simply darker.

messages.title: One client relationship, two useful revenue moments
messages.preview: Make aftercare a natural part of the client’s glow plan.
messages.headline: One client relationship, two useful revenue moments.

blocks.html: The strongest partner relationship does more than place a solution in the treatment room. It creates a coherent client journey.

In the appointment, the professional solution supports a premium named service. After the appointment, a focused retail edit gives clients a way to maintain or extend the result: a maintenance mitt, a tinted top-up in the right depth, or a premium routine and gift.
That is treatment revenue and relevant aftercare from the same client relationship — without discounting and without turning the front desk into an overstocked retail wall.

blocks.html: A premium product only works when the team can present it, recommend it and deliver the result with confidence. That is why the first step is a trial and a conversation — not a large commitment.
